definition: The primary part of a strata, condominium, or other volumetric parcel intended for the principal occupation or use associated with that parcel.
An open or substantially unenclosed area associated with a parcel, typically at or near ground level, that forms part of or is allocated for the use of that parcel.
A spatial area or volume designated for the parking of a motor vehicle and associated with a parcel.
A spatial area or volume designated for the storage of goods or possessions and associated with a parcel.
An elevated external or partially external spatial area associated with a parcel, typically adjoining a principal unit and intended for the use of its occupants.
A spatial area or volume at, within, or above the roof level of a building that is included in or allocated for the use of a parcel.
A spatial area or volume allocated for the exclusive or restricted use of a particular parcel or its occupants, without necessarily forming part of the parcel's principal unit.
